name: tempboard
description: Temporary, link-shared collaborative whiteboard (Excalidraw-based, live cursors, LaTeX math, Korean fonts). One command gives an invite link via a Cloudflare quick tunnel; also an always-on personal board on your own domain (named tunnel, optional Cloudflare Access), .excalidraw import, and a stdio MCP server so Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity agents can read and draw on boards.
